verdict.rationale: There is no explicit bulk-operations feature in the evidence. Bulk changes are only implied: jitsu-cli and the Management API can manage workspace configuration objects (destinations, streams, connections) and could be scripted to act on many at once. The MCP server lets an agent create and wire up pipeline objects, and dead-lettered events can be replayed in bulk by a reprocessing worker. Missing for 10: a documented native bulk-edit/bulk-action capability across many items, explicit batch endpoints or commands for multi-object changes, and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
